hook_say: every black friday banner says 'up to'. at these eight stores, 40 to 56% of everything really is 40% off or more. i counted.
sub: i counted every in-stock product, store by store

brands.stat: half the store is 50% off or more
brands.say: daze denim. the site says 25% off. half the store is 50 off or more, and most of that is 65. jeans that were 118 are 41 dollars. a lot of it is prints and shorts, so pick carefully.

brands.stat: 45% of the store is 40% off or more
brands.say: intentionally blank says up to 75% off sitewide, and the whole store really is marked down. 45% of it is 40 off or more, and the black knee-high boots are half off, 162 down from 324.

brands.claim: 30% off sitewide + up to 65% off sale
brands.stat: 44% of the store is 40% off or more
brands.say: hanky panky is 30% off sitewide, but 44% of the store is 40 off or more. the thong 3-packs are half off, 27 instead of 54. the deepest cuts are swimsuits, in november, so think vacation.

brands.stat: 44% of the store is 40% off or more
brands.say: lake pajamas says 25% off sitewide. i counted 44% of the store at 40 off or more. the fair isle set is 62 instead of 124. nothing goes past 50 though, so don't wait for more.

brands.stat: half the store is 50% off or more
brands.say: alexandra miro says 20 to 50% off, and half the store really is 50 or more. the scarf print mini is 192, it was 480. but almost all of it is final sale, so know your size first.

brands.stat: 56% of the store is 40% off or more
brands.say: anemos only advertises 20% off with a code. but more than half the store is already marked 40 off or more. the halter midi starts at 150, it was 495. heads up, sale pieces are final sale.

brands.stat: 40% of the store is 40% off or more
brands.say: m.m.lafleur, up to 70% off. 40% of the store is 40 off or more and a third is past half. this is the one for work clothes: the black taka wrap dress is 94, down from 429.

brands.stat: 41% of the store is 40% off or more
brands.say: emme parsons calls it a private sale, no number on the homepage. 41% of the store is 40 off. these are still 387 dollar heels, down from 645, so only if you've wanted a pair for a while.

close_say: that's eight where the markdowns are real. which store should i count next?
end_text: the banner vs. what's really marked down

caption: Eight Black Friday sales where a big share of the store really is 40% off or more, counted product by product on Nov 26-27. Some of these advertise way less than they're giving. Which store do you want me to count next? Commissionable links in bio.
pinned_comment: how i counted: every in-stock product on each site, share marked 40% off or more vs its own original price, read Nov 26-27. alexandra miro and anemos sale pieces are final sale. i left out stores where nearly everything is always 'on sale', those original prices don't mean much.
